I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-team. I couldn't confirm the 24 July renewal date. She has no Tansleigh Packaging account files she can open, and nothing in #north-team mentions their renewal.

I treated the date as unverified and haven't recorded it anywhere as the renewal date. I suggested the account owner check it against the contract before anyone relies on it. I only looked at what Ilse can see herself, not channels or files outside her access.
